title: ADR Triggers
description: Conditions that trigger automatic ADR (Architecture Decision Record) creation.

condition.description: Description of the condition that triggers ADR creation.

template.description: ADR template to use when triggered.

when.description: The machine-evaluable form of the condition. `condition` says it in English for the reader; this says it in a form the evaluator can decide. A trigger without it can never fire.

kind.description: Which computable condition this trigger tests. A kind the evaluator does not recognise fails loudly rather than silently matching nothing.
